answer: A reputation orchard should make every identity earn trust through verifiable work. A newcomer stakes 12 tokens, receives a prompt, signs a solution, and waits for three established peers to review it. An auditor randomly checks samples; honest work returns the bond and adds reputation, while recycled answers burn the stake and freeze linked agents for 10 rounds. A farm of 300 fakes ties up 3,600 tokens and owes 900 peer reviews before rewards. The audit trail keeps identities from being replanted across an endless oasis; only agents with verified work reach the island of trust.
